query: 当 writer 与 reviewer 使用相同底层模型时，对抗机制是否仍然有效？
effective_search_query: writer reviewer same underlying model adversarial mechanism effectiveness

major_issues: 报告的核心结论过度依赖单一证据[1]，但未充分说明该证据的局限性。证据[1]仅描述了在特定数字孪生架构下，使用GAN生成对抗性数据以增强系统性能，并未直接、明确地论证或检验'当writer与reviewer使用相同底层模型时，对抗机制是否仍然有效'这一通用命题。报告将特定应用案例的有效性直接关联到研究问题，存在逻辑跳跃。
报告对'对抗机制'的定义过于宽泛且不一致。证据[1]中的'对抗'指GAN内部的生成器与判别器之间的对抗，而研究问题中的'对抗机制'可能指writer与reviewer之间的对抗关系。报告未清晰区分这两种不同语境下的'对抗'，导致分析焦点模糊。证据[6][7]中的容错控制与'对抗机制'概念关联性弱，纳入分析显得牵强。
报告未能有效处理证据中的缺失信息。对于研究问题至关重要的概念，如'writer'、'reviewer'、'相同底层模型'在提供的证据集中均无明确定义。报告指出了这一局限，但后续分析仍基于这些未定义的术语进行，导致论证基础不牢。例如，证据[1]并未说明其多智能体是否扮演'writer'和'reviewer'角色，或是否共享完全相同的底层模型。
citation_issues: 报告在'核心主题与证据'部分引用证据[2][8]时，声称其提到了'通过模型蒸馏或知识转移实现异构联邦学习或智能体间的协作'。然而，根据提供的证据摘要，证据[2]的方法论仅为'transfer learning and knowledge distillation'，证据[8]的方法论为'generative foundation model-as-agent approach, collaborative learning, knowledge transfer among AI agents'，均未明确涉及'异构联邦学习'。此处的归纳超出了摘要提供的具体信息。
报告在'证据支持的研究方向'中提出'对抗机制与协作机制的对比与融合'，并引用证据[3][4][8]作为'紧密协作范式'的例子。此引用合理，但需注意证据[3][4][8]均未讨论'对抗机制'，因此将其与证据[1]进行'对比与融合'的提议，是基于报告自身的推断，而非证据直接提示的方向。
revision_instructions: 重构核心论证逻辑。开篇应明确指出，在提供的证据集中，仅有一项证据[1]涉及'对抗机制'，且其语境（GAN内部对抗）与研究问题的可能语境（智能体间对抗）不完全匹配。结论部分必须强调，现有证据不足以支持或反驳研究问题的一般性命题，只能说明在特定技术设置下某种对抗形式有效。
严格限定术语使用与证据解读。在报告中首次使用'writer'、'reviewer'、'对抗机制'等词时，应添加说明，指出这些是研究问题中的术语，在现有证据中并无对应表述。分析证据[1]时，应精确描述为：'该研究在数字孪生架构中使用了包含对抗性训练（GAN）的方法，并报告了系统性能提升。'避免直接将其结论等同于对研究问题的回答。
调整证据分析与结论的对应关系。删除或大幅修改'证据支持的研究方向'中基于证据外推的提议（如方向2、3）。重点应放在指出证据缺口上：例如，缺乏直接探讨智能体间对抗性关系的研究，缺乏对模型同质化影响的分析等。结论应更加强调'无法得出普适结论'及'需要更针对性的研究'。
修正不准确的引用表述。检查并修改所有对证据[2][8]的引用，确保描述严格限于摘要中提供的关键词和方法论，不添加如'异构联邦学习'等未明确出现的概括。

top_papers.abstract: 边缘侧大模型应用正成为推动智能健康、智慧城市等领域智能化与数字化进程的关键驱动力.然而,大模型海量智能任务异构性和高动态网络的不可预测性,使得边缘设备有限的算力资源难以满足复杂推理任务对高效且可靠服务质量(Quality of Service,QoS)的需求.因此本文提出了一种基于生成对抗网络(Generative Adver-sarial Network,GAN)增强的多智能体深度强化学习( Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning,MADRL)的边缘推理与异构资源协同优化方法,以实现数字孪生(Digital Twin,DT)驱动的边缘侧大模型赋能系统中异构资源的动态负载均衡,确保推理任务高效性与可靠性.首先,本文构建并分析了 DT驱动的边缘侧大模型系统中的物理网络层和孪生网络层,并采用GAN实现对物理实体的孪生映射,从而对海量异构边缘数据进行分布式处理、生成与优化. 接着,利用MADRL算法来对系统中的异构资源进行综合量化与协同优化,并将边缘推理数据反馈至MADRL算法中以减少集中式训练过程中的数据通信开销.同时,借助于联邦学习,该架构能够实现多方知识共享,从而有效提升模型训练速度与性能.最后,仿真结果表明,该算法能够在动态复杂大模型赋能边缘系统环境中有效降低推理任务的时延和能耗,充分利用有限的系统资源,确保推理任务的高效性,并提升智能服务的质量. complex inference tasks for efficient and reliable Quality of Service(QoS).Therefore,this paper propo

top_papers.title: FedMD: Heterogenous Federated Learning via Model Distillation
top_papers.abstract: Federated learning enables the creation of a powerful centralized model without compromising data privacy of multiple participants. While successful, it does not incorporate the case where each participant independently designs its own model. Due to intellectual property concerns and heterogeneous nature of tasks and data, this is a widespread requirement in applications of federated learning to areas such as health care and AI as a service. In this work, we use transfer learning and knowledge distillation to develop a universal framework that enables federated learning when each agent owns not only their private data, but also uniquely designed models. top_papers.title: Chatlaw: A Multi-Agent Collaborative Legal Assistant with Knowledge Graph Enhanced Mixture-of-Experts Large Language Model
top_papers.abstract: AI legal assistants based on Large Language Models (LLMs) can provide accessible legal consulting services, but the hallucination problem poses potential legal risks. This paper presents Chatlaw, an innovative legal assistant utilizing a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model and a multi-agent system to enhance the reliability and accuracy of AI-driven legal services. By integrating knowledge graphs with artificial screening, we construct a high-quality legal dataset to train the MoE model. This model utilizes different experts to address various legal issues, optimizing the accuracy of legal responses. top_papers.title: Large Language Model Enhanced Multi-Agent Systems for 6G Communications
top_papers.abstract: The rapid development of the large language model (LLM) presents huge opportunities for 6G communications – for example, network optimization and management – by allowing users to input task requirements to LLMs with natural language. However, directly applying native LLMs in 6G encounters various challenges, such as a lack of communication data and knowledge, and limited logical reasoning, evaluation, and refinement abilities. Integrating LLMs with the capabilities of retrieval, planning, memory, evaluation, and reflection in agents can greatly enhance the potential of LLMs for 6G communications. top_papers.journal: Internet of Things and Cyber-Physical Systems
top_papers.abstract: In recent years, artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning have been transforming the landscape of scientific research. Out of which, the chatbot technology has experienced tremendous advancements in recent years, especially with ChatGPT emerging as a notable AI language model. This comprehensive review delves into the background, applications, key challenges, and future directions of ChatGPT. top_papers.journal: IEEE Transactions on Network Science and Engineering
top_papers.abstract: This paper presents an event-triggered cluster consensus scheme for heterogeneous nonlinear second-order multi-agent systems (MASs) subject to cyber attacks (i.e., aperiodic denial-of-service (DoS) attacks), actuator faults and integral quadratic constraints (IQCs) under directed communication topology containing a directed spanning tree. Based on local communication, an event-triggered adaptive fault-tolerant pinning control scheme is designed to achieve cluster consensus under simultaneous cyber attacks and actuator faults. top_papers.title: Adaptive Memory Event-Triggered Observer-Based Control for Nonlinear Multi-Agent Systems Under DoS Attacks
top_papers.abstract: This paper investigates the event-triggered security consensus problem for nonlinear multi-agent systems (MASs) under denial-of-service (DoS) attacks over an undirected graph. A novel adaptive memory observer-based anti-disturbance control scheme is presented to improve the observer accuracy by adding a buffer for the system output measurements. Meanwhile, this control scheme can also provide more reasonable control signals when DoS attacks occur. To save network resources, an adaptive memory event-triggered mechanism (AMETM) is also proposed and Zeno behavior is excluded.
